name: Bull flag
idea: Within one session: a strong move up, then a tight, shallow consolidation; the signal is the first close above the consolidation that makes a new session high, on volume, for the session's first flags only. The idea is wrong below the consolidation's low.

params.label: The strong move (ATRs)
params.help: The move into the consolidation, at least this many average true ranges.

params.label: The strong move's most bars
params.help: The move takes at most this many bars.

params.label: Consolidation: fewest bars
params.help: The tight consolidation lasts at least this many bars.

params.label: Consolidation: most bars
params.help: The tight consolidation lasts at most this many bars.

params.label: Consolidation: most given back
params.help: The consolidation gives back at most this fraction of the move (shallow).

params.label: Volume expansion
params.help: The breaking bar's volume, at least this many times the average (0 means no volume condition).

params.label: Break distance
params.help: How far beyond the consolidation the close must be, in average true ranges (0 means any close beyond).

params.label: Flags per session
params.help: Only the first this many flag breaks of a session. Reference: 2.

params.label: A new low against (bars)
params.help: For the template's exit signal: a close beyond the low (high for the downside) of this many bars before it.

constraints.message: The consolidation's fewest bars cannot be more than its most bars.

setup.long: PatternBreakout("up", "flag", $vol_mult, $k, pole=$pole, pole_bars=$pole_bars, flag_min=$flag_min, flag_max=$flag_max, retrace=$retrace) AND high >= SessionHigh() AND SessionCount(PatternBreakout("up", "flag", $vol_mult, $k, pole=$pole, pole_bars=$pole_bars, flag_min=$flag_min, flag_max=$flag_max, retrace=$retrace)) <= $max_flags
setup.short: PatternBreakout("down", "flag", $vol_mult, $k, pole=$pole, pole_bars=$pole_bars, flag_min=$flag_min, flag_max=$flag_max, retrace=$retrace) AND low <= SessionLow() AND SessionCount(PatternBreakout("down", "flag", $vol_mult, $k, pole=$pole, pole_bars=$pole_bars, flag_min=$flag_min, flag_max=$flag_max, retrace=$retrace)) <= $max_flags

invalidation.long: PatternBreakoutRef("base_low", "up", "flag", $vol_mult, $k, pole=$pole, pole_bars=$pole_bars, flag_min=$flag_min, flag_max=$flag_max, retrace=$retrace)
invalidation.short: PatternBreakoutRef("base_high", "down", "flag", $vol_mult, $k, pole=$pole, pole_bars=$pole_bars, flag_min=$flag_min, flag_max=$flag_max, retrace=$retrace)
